question: September [2024] the Atacama Desert, where construction of the Extremely Large Telescope (ELT) is underway, is located in which country?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chile**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Atacama Desert, where the Extremely Large Telescope (ELT) is under construction, is located in **Chile**, South America.
 
• The Atacama Desert is considered one of the driest places on Earth, making it an ideal location for astronomical observations due to minimal atmospheric interference.
 
• The Extremely Large Telescope (ELT) is being built by the **European Southern Observatory (ESO)** and is expected to be the world’s largest optical/near-infrared telescope once completed.
 
• The ELT, with a primary mirror of 39 meters in diameter, aims to advance scientific understanding of the universe, including the study of exoplanets, black holes, and the early stages of galaxy formation.
 
• The high altitude and clear skies of the Atacama Desert, particularly at the Cerro Armazones site, provide optimal conditions for cutting-edge astronomical research.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Argentina**

 
 
• Argentina is known for its diverse landscapes, including the Andes Mountains and the Pampas grasslands.
 
• The country does host other observatories, such as the Pierre Auger Observatory, which studies cosmic rays.
 
 
 
• **Peru**
 
 
• Peru is famous for the Andes Mountains and the Amazon Rainforest, as well as archaeological sites like Machu Picchu.
 
 
 
• **Bolivia**
 
 
• Bolivia is known for its high-altitude salt flats, such as Salar de Uyuni, and the Andes Mountains.
